chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
The day my husband brought his assistant to the psychiatric hospital to take me home , I was being pinned to the floor and humiliated and tortured by the people restraining me . My six - year - old prodigy of a son stood outside the door and looked at his father with naked disgust . " Dad , she's filthy now . Just take her home and make her the nanny . " " Miss Ivy has a PhD . She's a much better fit to be your wife . " At that , my husband stepped forward and shielded his son and assistant behind him . He thought I would do what I had done two years ago , lose my mind and start screaming .

Instead , I merely pulled my clothes closed and nodded calmly . Once we were outside , I handed him the divorce papers myself and gave the master bedroom to his assistant . The moment my son wished for a different mother , I severed our mother - son relationship on the spot . Even when his assistant tried to provoke me with photos of the two of them in bed . I only meekly handed her a box of condoms . In the bedroom , my husband clenched his fists and asked how long I planned to keep pretending . I only smiled and set the lube on the table beside him . He had it wrong .

I was not pretending at all . In five more days , my ten - year mission would be over . I did not want either of them anymore , not the father and not the son . Julian Hayes was shirtless when he impatiently swept the things off the table and sent them skidding to my feet . " Sophie , if you really want to play the bigger person , take off the porcelain Virgin Mary pendant around your neck and leave it here . Ivy's pregnant . She needs it to keep herself calm . " The pendant was the keepsake my grandmother had left me , and I had always treasured it above everything else .

Julian knew that better than anyone . That was why he looked at me like a man certain he would get what he wanted . waiting for me to panic and beg the way I used to . Instead , I simply lifted a hand and placed the pendant in Ivy Parker's palm . " Anything else you want ? You might as well ask for all of it now ," I asked softly . I was leaving soon anyway . I would not be taking anything from this place with me . Chapter 1 15.500 Julian stared at me in disbelief , anger flickering in his eyes . " You'd better not regret this , Sophie Shaw .

" He thought I was still throwing a tantrum , still trying to bait him into turning back to me this way . But he had forgotten , and I had not . Two years ago , because I fought Ivy over that pendant , he had my clothes torn off on the spot and forced me to kneel naked in the snow as a live target for their shooting practice . The biting humiliation of it still sent my heart racing even now . I lowered my head obediently and was about to walk out when the pendant in Ivy's hand suddenly shattered . Blood welled up at once .

I turned to call for the private physician , but before I could say a word , an arrow came flying straight at me and sank hard into my shoulder . I staggered and braced myself against the wall . Before I could even open my mouth , Julian slammed into me from behind and shoved me aside . He pulled Ivy tight against his chest and frantically told the private physician to get there now . In the silent room , my precocious son stood there with a bow aimed at me . Disgust covered his face as he spoke . The second you came back , you made Miss Ivy unhappy .

I had to teach you a lesson you'll remember . " " You filthy thing . Why didn't you die in the psych ward ? Having a mother like you makes me- " Adrian ! " Julian cut off the cold words spilling from his son's mouth . Julian paused for a beat . He looked back at me once , then turned and went downstairs . Cradled in his arms , Ivy looked at me with unconcealed triumph . After all , everyone in our circle knew Adrian Hayes was my whole world . But this time , I only pressed a hand to my bleeding shoulder and spoke in a flat , distant voice . " You stopped being my son a long time ago .

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
12.50 Chapter 2 Under Adrian's resentful stare , I gently set the document severing our mother - son relationship on the table . Every word he spoke and every move he made had always been stiff and solemn , more like a grown man than a little boy . The only thing he ever showed any real interest in was archery . So I searched everywhere for the best coaches and got him into the top club I could find .

When Adrian was four , he had looked up at me with worship in his eyes , clutching a tiny bow in his hands . " Mom , once I learn archery , I'll protect you . " " Don't think this will make me feel sorry for you . " The last note in his voice trembled slightly . I did not answer .

As I passed by . I heard my son's fawning voice from inside . " Mommy Ivy , don't be mad . Once you're disch that bad woman for you . I didn't mean to play that video in front of you . Julian was just using it to cheer me up . " " I forgot to turn it off . I'm so sorry . " I saw red . So Julian had known all along . He knew exactly what those two years had been like for me . He knew I had lived worse than an animal .

He knew I had been tortured until life itself felt worse than death . And yet , to him , those hellish days were nothing more than something to use for entertainment . I stared at the man I had loved for ten years , trying to find even a trace of guilt in him . But in his eyes , there was only the irritation of being caught . I laughed from sheer fury . Julian , this is what came of sending me in there to learn how to behave and how to play the bigger person . Aren't you satisfied ? The moment I finished speaking , darkness began to gather at the edges of my vision .

" She waved the phone in her hand and , in deliberate provocation , sent the video to my younger sister , who had only just made it out of the ICU . She was the only family I had left in this world . The last taut string in my mind snapped . I grabbed the scalpel beside me and slashed toward her face . Even if I had to die . I was taking her with me . But the instant the blade touched her face , Julian kicked me viciously to the ground . Hearing the noise , my son rushed in as well and smashed the IV bottle into my face . He screamed , " You psycho . Just die .

" Through the blood blurring my vision , Julian and Adrian looked down at me from above . " Sophie , it's been two years , and you're still this vicious . You actually tried to hurt Ivy right in front of me . " A tear slipped down and vanished into the blood . I arched a brow and spoke one word at a time . " Julian , do you know what the biggest regret of my life is? It was meeting you , and then giving birth to this bastard . " The moment the words fell , Julian's face changed dramatically . Adrian froze too .

He stared at me blankly , as if he could not believe I was the one who had said it . After a few seconds of silence , he pressed his lips together and turned away . " Dad , she still hasn't learned her lesson . You should send her back and make her learn some manners . " Julian closed his eyes and agreed in a hard , emotionless voice . " You're right . Julian , don't send me back . I'm begging you . Please don't send me back there . " " I'll do whatever you want . If you want me to go crazy , I'll go crazy . Instead , I remained there , drifting around them in spirit form . The system appeared again . Now they strapped her into it and turned the setting all the way up so she could feel exactly what that was like . Ivy's screams tore through the room . The viewers called it satisfying as hell , and the comments were flooded with people repeating that she deserved it . But that round was only the beginning . Next came a steel ruler . They often used that ruler to strike the parts of my body hidden under my clothes . They had vicious ways of using it , and the pain was often unbearable . This time , Julian and Adrian had the ruler altered so that the smooth metal edge was lined with barbs .

Ivy looked up in horror . " No. You can't do this to me . " " It was my fault . Please , just let me go . " " Don't you want to save her ? I have a system too . I have a way . " But Julian and Adrian only shook their heads impatiently and signaled for the others to begin. They brought the ruler down on Ivy again and again , watching her whole body convulse from the agony . But every time she rolled or twisted , the barbs sank deeper into her flesh .

By the time they finally carried her out , she was covered in blood She had not even had time to catch her breath when Julian clapped his hands and signaled for the doctor to come * However they ripped the ceramic shards out before , do the same to her now ' * Remember , no anesthesia . Pull them out raw , ' Without anesthesia , Ivy - already covered in wounds - was tortured until she could barely make a sound . Chanter 7 She barely had a chance to breathe . She looked like she'd already died once .

Even when she tried to pass out from the pain , someone would immediately splash saline across her face to wake her again . Watching her being tortured , I shook my head and closed my eyes . What was the point ? She was not the true mastermind . Still , she had put me through hell , so all of this was something she had brought on herself . I closed my eyes and listened to the sound of the system successfully restarting beside me . With a quiet sigh . I prepared to return to the real world .

On the other side , the livestream's popularity stayed sky - high , but Julian and Adrian no longer cared about any of it . They liquidated all of the company's assets and poured every dollar into the system reboot plan . Apparently , they had overheard my conversation with the system that day . They had gone mad , mad enough to give up everything just to rebuild the system , find me , and atone for what they'd done . I listened to the system's report . Looking at the regret in their eyes , I found it all absurd .

They thought that if they rebooted the system and found me , they could somehow make up for everything they had done . They were wrong In this life , I wanted nothing more than never to see them again . The system seemed to understand my resolve . [ Don't worry , host .

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.content:
Under a blinding halo of light , I returned to the real world . Sunlight settled over my shoulders , warm in a way that almost did not feel real . I had finally made it home after that cursed mission . Because completing it had been so brutal , the system added another two million dollars to the original five - million - dollar reward . I used the money to buy myself a small house and a car of my own . Then , after figuring out what I still had left in savings , I donated another two million dollars to struggling rural communities .

I started learning how to live again and kept myself busy little by little . The damage that mission had done to me seemed to be fading . And then the right person came into my life . He remembered every little thing I liked . When I occasionally drifted off , he would gently take my hand . And when nightmares woke me in the middle of the night , he would pat me softly and tell me everything was okay . After the system paid out the reward , it went silent , as if it had disappeared completely . But I could never shake the feeling that something was wrong .

Then one day , that peace was shattered for good . I was walking down the street beside my boyfriend when the system , silent for so long , suddenly blared to life . For the first time , its voice was full of outright terror . [ Warning Warning The parallel world has completely collapsed . The people tied to the mission have forced their way into this world ! The moment the system's warning ended , two filthy , ragged figures crashed to the ground .

When I looked closely , I saw that they were Julian and Adrian Their hair was dry and matted , but the instant they saw me , overwhelming joy exploded across their faces The two of them scrambled toward me on hands and knees , only to stop a short distance away Their eyes were full of joy , yet they looked at me with guilt as they kept whispering . Tim sorry " Adrian's voice shook violently . " Mom , I know I was wrong . I already made that evil woman pay Chapter 8 " Please don't be mad at me , Mom . " Julian hunched over as well , ingratiating and desperate .

" Sophie , we know we were wrong . Come back with us , okay ? We'll behave this time . I'll love you the way I should have . I swear . " We were out of our minds before . You can beat us or kill us if you want . Just please don't abandon us . " They had lowered themselves into the dust before me . But I only looked at them calmly and found the whole thing faintly ridiculous . After ten years of that mission , the remorse and apologies I had longed for while I was alive came easily , but only after I had died . But who remembered the pain Sophie had endured in that world ?

Beside me , my boyfriend stepped in front of me protectively . " Don't be scared . I'm here . " I gently took his hand , and the warmth at my fingertips slowly steadied me . Then I looked at the two pathetic figures in front of me and asked softly . " Who are you ? " The indifference in my voice shattered the last of the hope inside them . They stood there in a daze , staring at my back as I walked away hand in hand with my boyfriend . " How is this possible ? How could she not remember us ? " " No. This isn't how it's supposed to be . She's just still too angry .

" When they realized I had lost those memories , they ran out of options and started going after the system instead . So they returned to their original world and began causing chaos on purpose , planning to destroy that entire world to force the system to restore my old memories . The system had no other choice but to come beg me for help . Host , for the sake of the people in that world . please help ] Turning the ring my boyfriend had given me around my finger .

I let out a sigh and agreed The other people in that world were innocent , after all When I returned to that world again , the first thing I saw after opening my eyes was Adrian running toward me with joy all over his face . " Mom , you're back . Do you remember who I am now ? I'm your favorite little boy . " Chapter 8 I let out a cold laugh , mockery clear in my eyes . " That's not how I remember it . " " Didn't you already cut ties with me ? " The joy on Adrian's face froze instantly . He bit his lip and choked out , " Mom , I'm sorry . I was just too afraid of losing you .

" Julian arrived right behind him and nodded . " Sophie , we went about it the wrong way . We know we were wrong . " I looked at them coldly . " You know you were wrong ? You tormented me for ten years . How could one apology possibly erase any of that ? " I paused . " Julian , someone like you was never worthy of being loved . " " And Adrian , neither were you . Stop wasting your time trying to make me come back . Just looking at either of you makes me sick to my stomach . " Adrian started trembling all over as he looked at me helplessly . " Mom , can you give us one more chance to atone ?

" " A chance ? " I nodded . " Sure ." " If you really want to atone , then go die . " The Sophie in your hearts is already dead . If you want to apologize , go apologize to her . " Silence fell as they stared greedily at my face . Then , in the very next second , both of them nodded at the same time . Their eyes were full of sick , almost pathological obedience . " Okay . Then we'll die " " If our deaths will make you happy " After that , they gave me one last look , then turned and jumped . The screams of the bystanders rose with the cutting wind rushing past me .

All I felt was my heart clench hard in my chest . At the same time , the system's voice rang out . Chapter 8 [ Disruptors eliminated . Original world order is being restored ] [ Welcome home , host . ] A wide road appeared before me . At the end of it . sunlight poured bright and clear . I took a deep breath and stepped forward slowly . The darkness behind me faded away . Ahead of me was a better future .
